verdict.rationale: The pack does not document an ops user adding custom fields or properties through the UI, nor saved record views that are filtered, sorted and shared. The custom objects material describes developer APIs ("Create and update custom object records with the custom objects API"), which is a developer building block rather than a no-admin capability. The reporting dashboard claims about filters and permissions cover reports, an adjacent feature, not CRM record views, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project
